Dahua 2.5-inch DH-SSD-C800S128G SATA 128GB SSD

The Dahua 2.5-inch DH-SSD-C800S128G SATA SSD offers an efficient and reliable storage solution for users seeking enhanced performance in their laptops and personal computers. With a capacity of 128GB, this solid-state drive is ideal for storing operating systems, applications, and essential files, ensuring quick access and improved system responsiveness. This SSD delivers impressive sequential read speeds of up to 500MB/s and write speeds of 400MB/s, allowing for swift data transfer and reduced load times. In addition to its robust sequential performance, it boasts remarkable random read and write speeds of 37,000 IOPS and 57,000 IOPS, respectively, making it suitable for multitasking and demanding applications. Built with a SATA interface, the DH-SSD-C800 is designed to fit seamlessly into various devices. It features a compact 2.5-inch form factor, measuring 100.20mm in length, 69.90mm in width, and just 7.00mm in height, making it an excellent choice for upgrading older systems without taking up much space. The SSD is engineered for durability, with a mean time between failures (MTBF) of 150WH and a total bytes written (TBW) rating of 60TB, ensuring long-term reliability for daily use. It also supports advanced features such as SMART information viewing, TRIM, and garbage collection, which enhance performance and extend the lifespan of the drive. With operating temperatures ranging from 0℃ to 70℃ and a wide storage temperature range of -40℃ to +85℃, the DH-SSD-C800 can operate effectively in various environmental conditions. Weighing just 40g, this SSD is lightweight and easy to install, making it an ideal choice for users looking to enhance their computing experience with reliable storage performance. Backed by a 3-year limited warranty, the Dahua DH-SSD-C800S128G SATA SSD ensures peace of mind for all your data storage needs.

Features of the Dahua 2.5-inch DH-SSD-C800S128G SATA 128GB SSD

  • Capacity: Provides a storage capacity of 128GB, suitable for OS installations, applications, and essential files.
  • Sequential Read Speed: Up to 500MB/s, enabling fast data access.
  • Sequential Write Speed: Up to 400MB/s for quick file transfers.
  • Random Read IOPS: 37,000 IOPS for efficient multitasking.
  • Random Write IOPS: 57,000 IOPS for responsive performance.
  • MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures): Rated at 150WH for reliable operation.
  • TBW (Total Bytes Written): 60TB, ensuring longevity for everyday use.
  • Shock Resistance: Capable of withstanding shocks of 1500G for 0.5ms.
  • Interface: Utilizes a SATA interface for compatibility with various devices, including laptops and PCs.
  • TRIM Support: Enhances performance by allowing the OS to inform the SSD about unused data blocks.
  • Garbage Collection: Maintains optimal performance over time.
  • SMART Support: Provides real-time health monitoring of the SSD.
  • Size: Measures 100.20mm x 69.90mm x 7.00mm, fitting easily into 2.5-inch drive bays.
  • Lightweight: Weighs only 40g, making it easy to handle and install.
  • Warranty: Backed by a 3-year limited warranty, providing peace of mind for users.
